_about: The count for San Diego College of Continuing Education's All Fields report (4) on sdccd.curriqunet.com, trial 45017581874 (S703). The trial filed each page's text, so each count is read off the filed page apart from the parser: the worker listed each page's objectives field and its Objective Text entries, and read HMID 535 and HSDP 403 line by line. No page prints a student learning outcomes heading, so every SLO count is 0. The parser files 10 of 12 right: HMID 535's empty field runs on into Legacy Data (2 filed, 0 printed) and HSDP 403's one entry reads 'See specific course outline.' (1 filed, 0 objectives). The load drops both (FIELD_END, POINTER in kb/_course_outcomes_load.py), so the loaded rows match all 12. sdccd.curriqunet.com is not an outcomes-only host, so no reader gate reads this file; tests/course_outcomes_load_test.py does.
